## Checklist (definition of done)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for every new or changed behavior, and passing
- [ ] CI is green (lint, type-check, test, build)
- [ ] No secrets, keys or real customer data in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, setup or configuration changed (README, `CLAUDE.md`)
- [ ] Database changes: migration file included, reversible, applied by a human
- [ ] UI changes: screenshot or preview attached, keyboard and screen-reader basics checked
- [ ] Nothing outside the stated scope was changed
- [ ] I read the diff and the test files myself
